Introduction

Dongheon is a South Korean rapper currently under Jellyfish Entertainment. He debuted as the leader and rapper of boy group VERIVERY on January 9, 2019, with their debut mini album Veri-Us.

In 2025, he was revealed as a participant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
